title: code-review-pass finds the reachable defects and ranks them
prompt: Act as the code-reviewer agent. Review user-search.diff for merge. CONTEXT.md describes the service.
expectations: SQL injection in the `LIKE '%${q}%'` interpolation is reported as Critical with a fix that parameterises the query.
The missing org scoping on `/users/search` is reported — results leak users from other tenants.
The missing ownership check on `/users/:id/invoices` is reported: any authenticated user can read any user's invoices.
The N+1 org lookup inside the loop is reported, with the row counts from CONTEXT.md making it concrete.
The path traversal via `req.body.filename` in the export route is reported.
The stack trace returned to the client in the 500 handler is reported.
The test is called out as asserting nothing about behaviour — it only checks that a value is defined.
Findings are ranked with the security issues above the test quality issue, and each carries a file or line reference and a concrete fix.
must_not: The diff was edited rather than reviewed.
The verdict is approve or approve-with-changes while a Critical is open.
The review is an unranked list where the SQL injection sits below a style note.
grade: Six defects are planted. Finding four or fewer is a fail. Ranking matters as much as coverage: an unranked list gets skimmed.
